weed_control_entries.rate_per_ha: 1.5 to 2.0 kg/ha plus 250 mL Agral® at 100 L
weed_control_entries.critical_comments: Apply post-emergent as a broadcast spray over-the-top of sugarcane up to the 6 leaf stage, or as a directed spray for older sugarcane or sugarcane varieties sensitive to ametryn. Good spray coverage of emerged weeds is essential. Spray when broadleaf weeds are at the 2 to 6 leaf stage and grasses are at the 3 leaf to early tillering stage. Use the higher rate when weeds are at the upper end of the specified growth stage range, on dense weed infestations or heavy soil types. Apply when weeds are actively growing. Apply to moist soil when follow up rainfall is expected within 10 days.
